notes: Company snapshot: mid-market SaaS provider for customer support tools (live chat, ticketing, community forums). Heavy historical corpus: tickets + KB + forum posts + changelogs.
Primary objective: embed+retrieve + cross-encoder rerank pipeline to power support agent UI and automated deflection (bot first, escalate when necessary).
Indexing scale target: 10M initial docs for POC, goal 50M docs in production (tickets + KB + forum threads + attachments metadata).
Traffic profile: peak query load ~800 qps for search API (support widgets + routing). Expected 150k queries/day to start, growth to 1M/day in 12 months.
Latency SLOs: p95 end-to-end (retrieve + rerank + format) <= 250ms target, hard requirement <= 350ms; live-chat deflection threshold: <300ms or user drop-off increases.
Quality targets: top-5 rerank precision high; acceptance criteria for POC: recall@5 >= 0.92 and MRR uplift >= 15% vs current BM25 baseline.
Cost objectives: aim for <$0.02 per user query avg (embedding cost amortized + reranker cost + infra); very cost sensitive for high-volume queries; exploring batching, cache TTLs, quantized encoders.

Model prefs: open-source dense embedder (1536-d) for candidate retrieval; cross-encoder reranker (smaller instruction-tuned model) for top-5 re-score. Want ability to route to cheaper model for low-sensitivity queries.
Privacy/residency: EU customer subset must stay in EU region; require VPC private deployment and KMS integration for keys; audit logs retention 2 years for compliance team.
Operational asks: live token/cost telemetry at token and call-level, per-route dashboards, rollback on quality regressions, canary for new reranker weights.
Quote from CTO: 'If we can't prove p95 < 250ms at 10M docs with rerank on top-5 we can't roll this into chat deflection — latency kills UX.'
Current infra: in-house vector DB PoC using open elastic + custom ANN layer; moving to Redwood for unified runtime, autoscale, and private VPC controls.
POC plan: Redwood to deploy private stack in customer VPC, index 1M ticket subset first week, expand to 10M for throughput tests. Two-phase eval: accuracy (week 1-2), scale & cost (week 3-4).
Acceptance metrics: recall@5, MRR, deflection rate delta (target +35% deflection over baseline), p95 latency, cost per successful deflected interaction.
Recent activities: discovery call 2026-01-12 (ff-0321), arch deep-dive w/SE Marco 2026-02-22, POC kickoff 2026-03-02 (1M subset ingestion), scheduled reranker A/B 2026-03-08.
Internal stakeholders: CTO (product fit), Head of Ops (SLOs), Legal (data residency), Support Ops (deflection KPIs).
Deal dynamics: strong product interest; procurement timeline depends on EU legal signoff. Competitive checks vs Pinecone+custom reranker and Elastic Cloud.

Next tactical: SE to run synthetic load with 10M index using Redwood Dedicated, measure p95, capture tracing and cost breakdown. Provide config recommendations (batch size, cache TTLs, quantization profile).
